definitions: A highly contagious viral disease of cloven-hoofed animals, especially cattle, sheep, and pigs, characterized by the formation of blisters in the mouth and on the feet.
Also known as FMD, it can cause severe production losses and is a major concern for livestock industries worldwide.
examples: The outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease led to mass culling.
Vaccination programs are crucial to control foot-and-mouth disease.
Farmers are vigilant against foot-and-mouth disease.
